release_headline: ADOCIA publie ses résultats financiers du premier semestre 2026 et dresse un bilan de ses activités

print_vs_bar_note: Cash EUR9.7m and runway to early Q2 2027 are identical to the 23 July bar. H1 net loss EUR8.6m vs EUR9.3m prior year (abcbourse: https://www.abcbourse.com/marches/adocia-reduit-sa-perte-au-premier-semestre-2026-et-vise-une-demande-dautorisati_703097).

release_headline: Capricorn Energy PLC Half-Year Report Announcement, 24 Sep 2026 07:00
print_vs_bar_note: No consensus exists (hunter's bar unsourced); H1 production 19,337 boepd vs guidance 18,000-22,000 (slightly above midpoint), revenue USD 100m, cash USD 114m.
surprise_size_note: Small move on an irrelevant print; the real risk was the competing Genel bid, which the hunter's bar missed.
source: post-mortem filled 2026-09-28 by a general-purpose subagent from the release and same-day coverage; secondary sources flagged in notes
moved_on_evidence: Contested takeover, not the interims: the hunter's premise that the DNO USD 5.214 price was fixed was wrong - Genel also had a live firm offer and raised to USD 5.74 on 25 Sep (shares +12% that day); the +1.8% on 24 Sep fits bid-battle positioning.
guidance_detail: Production tracking slightly above the midpoint of 18,000-22,000 boepd 2026 guidance; no change.

release_headline: Preliminary Full Year Results FY26 — Strategic execution drives strong profit growth and deleveraging; customer proposition at record strength
print_vs_bar_note: FY26 uPBT(A) £44.9m vs company-compiled consensus £44.8m (+0.2%) and 'around £45m' guidance (-0.2%). Revenue £1,057.5m vs £1,060.4m consensus.
guidance_detail: 'Moderate profit growth in FY27 in line with analyst consensus' of £48.0m uPBT(A); first 12 weeks of FY27 order intake -2.5% YoY, 'in line with our expectations'.
moved_on_evidence: Low confidence. Shares were flat to +1% in early trade (146.5p vs 145.0p); the only soft new datapoint was order intake -2.5% in the first 12 weeks of FY27. The -1.4% close is within ordinary noise.

findings_scored.note: The Man Wah stake is not addressed in the release; the stake-building facts were not re-verified.
The freight sensitivity (£7-8m per $1,000/container) is quoted verbatim, but the company did not flag a FY27 freight headwind and stood by the £48.0m FY27 consensus.

surprise_size_note: Small move for an in-line, pre-guided print with consensus reiterated, which fits a non-surprise.
source: post-mortem filled 2026-09-28 by a general-purpose subagent from the release and same-day coverage; secondary sources flagged in notes

company: H&M Hennes & Mauritz AB Class B
release_headline: H & M Hennes & Mauritz AB Nine-month report 2026
print_vs_bar_note: Q3 operating profit SEK 6,037m vs the hunter's Modular Finance bar of SEK 5,095m (+18.5%); vs the LSEG mean of SEK 5.14bn, +17.5%. Gross margin 54.0% vs 53.4% expected. Sales SEK 57,189m, +1% in local currency. The beat included a one-off tariff benefit of ~1.6pp of sales (derived ≈SEK 0.9bn).
guidance_detail: No quantified outlook; September sales expected +1% in local currencies (the same sluggish rate); H&M said it does not expect further tariff refunds.

prior_update.note: Only June sales were given on 2026-06-25; the quarter's numbers were not pre-disclosed.

moved_on_evidence: Reuters: the profit beat came from a one-off US tariff refund (no more expected), while sales grew only 1% (vs Inditex +9%) and September was guided at +1%. The stock fell on the quality of the beat and on sales momentum.

findings_scored.note: Family buying on the report day and the short build were not verified; the claimed cushion did not stop a -2% day.
The tariff refund did land in the Jun-Aug P&L outside the bar (~1.6pp of sales). The hunter under-sized it (≈SEK 0.6-0.7bn expected vs ≈0.9bn), and the market discounted it as one-off.

surprise_size_note: A large headline beat (+18.5% on EBIT) met a small negative move, because the market stripped out the one-off refund and read the weak sales as the real news.
source: post-mortem filled 2026-09-28 by a general-purpose subagent from the release and same-day coverage; secondary sources flagged in notes

release_headline: Record first-half revenue and profitability; continued strong growth in unit shipments
print_vs_bar_note: H1 adjusted EBITDA $40.3m vs 'at least $38m' is +6.1%. Revenue was $256.9m (+90%). FY EBITDA is now 'expected to be ahead of market consensus'. One news summary put the prior consensus at about $42m, against the hunter's $57.8m from the company page; that is unverified and conflicting.
guidance_detail: The outlook says full-year EBITDA is expected to be ahead of market consensus, with H2 unit volumes above H1 on a backlog that doubled to 2.6m units. The first-half memory windfall has moderated.

prior_update.note: Nothing within 3 months. The 5 Jun trading update (about 3.6 months prior) had pre-disclosed H1 EBITDA of at least $38m.

moved_on_evidence: Coverage leads on the full-year outlook upgrade ('ahead of consensus') and record H1, with shares up about 19% to 979.5p early.

findings_scored.note: Right direction, far too small. The price had de-rated and no warning came; the company went further than a reaffirmation and upgraded.
H1 EBITDA was $40.3m, modestly above $38m, as predicted.
Register data. The small negative lean was swamped by the move.

surprise_size_note: The move was large (+19.6%) because an upgrade landed on a stock down about 41% since June; the hunter's +0.4% expected move badly underestimated the relief.
source: post-mortem filled 2026-09-28 by a general-purpose subagent from the release and same-day coverage; secondary sources flagged in notes

release_headline: Solaria dispara su beneficio un 50%, hasta 124,9 millones, en el primer semestre de 2026
print_vs_bar_note: Bar: Sabadell Q2 EBITDA ~EUR92m. H1 EBITDA EUR210.1m minus Q1 EUR113.2m (hunter's cited Q1) = ~EUR96.9m Q2, +5.3% vs bar (derived, not reported directly). But H1 net profit EUR124.9m vs Sabadell-implied ~EUR135m (-7.5%) and vs Benzinga ~EUR128m (-2.4%); revenue EUR167.2m vs XTB-cited consensus EUR188m (-11%). Sources: bolsamania link above; https://www.xtb.com/es/analisis-de-mercado/las-acciones-de-solaria-se-desploman-un-6-5-antes-de-sus-resultados-que-esta-pasando
guidance_detail: FY26 EBITDA target of EUR331m reaffirmed (64% achieved in H1); updated plan deferred to a November Investor Day.
moved_on_evidence: Spanish press attributes the -6.47% (close EUR15.18 vs 16.23; IBEX -0.30%) to short-seller pressure (5.61% of capital) with no negative news or rating changes; the release was published around midday (bolsamania article 13:47 CEST) and XTB's piece frames the fall as pre-results, so timing within the day is ambiguous. Mixed print (EBITDA ahead, revenue and net light vs consensus) may have contributed.

findings_scored.note: EBITDA modestly beat Sabadell's Q2 bar as predicted, but revenue/net profit came in below consensus and the claimed 'up on D at each of the last five prints' is contradicted for Q1: pressdigital reports -6.34% on 2026-05-19 after the Q1 release (https://www.pressdigital.es/articulo/economia/2026-05-19/5887674-solaria-pierde-634-bolsa-conseguir-alza-50-beneficio-primer-trimestre).
5.61% disclosed short confirmed by press; but shorts pressed rather than covered — the sign was wrong.

surprise_size_note: The release was a mixed, roughly in-line print with guidance reiterated, yet the stock fell 6.5% — large relative to the surprise, attributed by press to short positioning rather than the numbers.
source: post-mortem filled 2026-09-28 by a general-purpose subagent from the release and same-day coverage; secondary sources flagged in notes

release_headline: Verbio SE: Strong operating cash flow underlines the quality of earnings in the financial year 2025/26
print_vs_bar_note: FY26/27 EBITDA guide EUR210-250m (midpoint 230) vs the hunter's EUR265.81m finanzen.net consensus is -13.5%. Against the EUR241m consensus quoted by goldesel it is -4.6% (https://goldesel.de/aktien/news/verbio-aktie-fallt-nach-jahreszahlen-ebitda-ausblick-bleibt-hinter-erwartungen-zuruck). The reported FY25/26 EBITDA of EUR193.9m vs the ad-hoc c.EUR192m is +1.0%.
guidance_detail: The first FY26/27 guide is group EBITDA of EUR210-250m, with the midpoint below the analyst consensus.

prior_update.note: The ad-hoc preliminary FY EBITDA of c.EUR192m pre-disclosed the year. Its exact date was not re-verified.

moved_on_evidence: Coverage states the share fell because the FY26/27 EBITDA guidance midpoint was below analyst expectations.

findings_scored.note: The guide midpoint (EUR230m) came in below consensus and the stock fell on it, exactly as predicted.
The dividend was reinstated at EUR0.20, the level the hunter named. It was a small positive that was ignored ('Kurs zuckt nicht').

surprise_size_note: A modest guide miss (-5% to -13% depending on the consensus used) produced a modest -3.1% move, roughly proportionate. The hunter's -0.4% sizing was too small.
source: post-mortem filled 2026-09-28 by a general-purpose subagent from the release and same-day coverage; secondary sources flagged in notes

release_headline: Vistry Group PLC - Half year results for the period ended 30 June 2026
print_vs_bar_note: Main bar FY26 adj PBT GBP200m; new guide ~GBP165m (-17.5%). H1 adjusted loss before tax GBP83.3m vs bar of c.GBP30m loss; the company says ~GBP50m of the H1 figure is early CEO-review impacts, so ex-review ~GBP33m loss, roughly in line with the bar. Reported LBT GBP661.3m incl. GBP475m goodwill impairment. Year-end net cash guide cut from >GBP100m to 'broadly neutral'. Sources: release URL; https://ts2.tech/en/vistrys-470-million-reset-sends-shares-down-6-9-no-equity-raise-expected/
guidance_detail: FY26 adj PBT cut to ~GBP165m from GBP200m, year-end net cash to broadly neutral from >GBP100m, ~GBP470m of restructuring charges, distributions suspended pending deleveraging; no equity raise expected.

prior_update.note: Trading update pre-guided the H1 loss (~GBP30m incl. GBP50m cash actions) and FY PBT GBP200m.

moved_on_evidence: Shares fell ~5-7% intraday on the GBP35m PBT downgrade, the net-cash guide cut and the GBP470m reset charges.
surprise_size_note: A material guidance cut (-17.5% PBT, net cash >GBP100m to neutral) plus a large reset produced only -3.13% on the window, small relative to the surprise, likely because a CEO-review reset was widely expected; the hunter's zero findings / 0% expected move missed the direction.
source: post-mortem filled 2026-09-28 by a general-purpose subagent from the release and same-day coverage; secondary sources flagged in notes
